scope: Standalone experiments on GB10. None of these prototypes is included in production. No quantized weight values changed.

planar_gguf.decision: Do not integrate: cold Q8 gains are modest and inconsistent across dominant geometries; canonical storage and MMQ conversion cost not justified by this proof. No production edits.

modes.0: Exact production prefetch_row arithmetic and launch geometry on original GGUF AoS bytes
modes.2: Field-planar aligned loads with prefetch of every field
modes.3: Field-planar aligned loads with prefetch of fields of at least16bytes

planar_gguf.timing_method: CUDA event timing around captured repeated kernels; interleaved forward/reverse modes,3 baseline samples and2 per candidate; hot same buffer and cold rotating >=256MiB; allocated original+candidate buffers are experiment-only. Eight-warp prefetch control matches production selected Q8 but is not dispatch baseline for low-density/short geometries.
integration_risks: Cannot retain another full dense-weight copy on memory-tight UMA
All prefill MMQ loads need canonical planar read support; unpack-per-request would erase prefill benefit
Every direct QTensor consumer and serializer needs explicit storage capability; changes cannot be confined to dense MMVQ

fixed_width_mmq.decision: Rejected; fixed-column bucket kernels lose to existing dynamic compact in all15timedcases. No production edits.
fixed_width_mmq.numerical: All tested outputs finite with max absolute difference0 after NaN-poisoning candidate output before validation. Three format/geometries, balanced512/2048/8192tokens plus2048moderate/heavy skew. Not an all-format qualification.
fixed_width_mmq.method: CUDA events around10launchiterations after3warmups; three interleaved samples per variant. Includes unchanged prepare plus3/4filtered full-capacity grids for candidate versus one dynamic grid for control. No CUDA graphs.
fixed_width_mmq.rationale: Separate widths reduce per-CTA resource reservation, but multiplied launches and skipped full grids outweigh benefit. A future per-bucket worklist can avoid skippedCTAs but is untested.
fixed_width_mmq.review: Uniform early return precedesbarriers; disjoint runtime-column buckets; same compact_columns/worklist mapping. Initial stale-output validation issue was corrected by parent before retainedtimings.

partitioned_mmq.decision: Rejected; per-width worklists remove most skipped-grid overhead but only tiny mixed wins remain, with regressions at main balanced512/2048gate cases. No production edits.
partitioned_mmq.numerical: All tested outputs finite and max absolute difference0 after NaN outputpoisoning. These15format/shape/routingcases are not an all-format qualification.
partitioned_mmq.method: Same existing MMQ arithmetic; separate16/32/64/128worklists generated by oneblock prefix scans; generic per-width upper bounds. CUDAevents after3warmups around10iterations,3interleaved samples each.

weighted_atomic_mmq.numerical_contract: Assignment dot products unchanged. F32 atomic weighted sums reassociate ascending-slot FMA and perform a rounded multiply before atomic addition. Global F32 atomics flush subnormal inputs/results. Tests bound normal finite data; not bitwise equivalent or a quality-equivalence claim.

followup_plain_grid_control.result: All six actual-shape cases regressed5.2-16.8%; no production edit.

integration_assessment.scope: Shared grouped compact GGUF down projection, all10supported MMQ formats; keep noncompact, LoRA/post-down transforms and unsupported activation fallbacks.
integration_assessment.api: Pass routing weights as Tensor with live actual-compute-stream guards, topk/token dimensions checked once; own zeroed aggregate/output tensors through graph replay via existing allocator/graph ownership.
integration_assessment.arithmetic: Existing F32 assignment dot is unchanged. Weighted atomic accumulation replaces slot-ordered FMA with rounded product plus unordered sum. Global atomicAdd also flushes subnormals. Final dtype cast remains once.
integration_assessment.dispatch: Current six cells are insufficient for a general policy. Aggregate-size/L2 reasoning is credible, but validate neighboring matrix dimensions/topk/routing distributions and allformats before choosing a cache-based policy; do not hardcode token8192 or this model.
integration_assessment.unit_validation: Strict unchanged assignment-dot reference plus per-element error bounds; include normal cancellation, signed zeros, subnormals, finite extreme scales, zero routing, repeated expert IDs, partial rows and16/32/64/128column tails. Poison both aggregate and final buffers before changed-input/routing graph replay.
integration_assessment.model_validation: Compare samecheckpoint baseline/candidate at identical teacher-forced histories; record full-logit maxabs/RMS/relative errors, target-token logprob and held-out crossentropy/perplexity deltas, argmax margins and agreement. Repeat candidate to characterize atomic nondeterminism; separately run greedy generations and matched performance fixture. No quality-equivalence claim from final-output layer error alone.
integration_assessment.decision: No production atomic integration this window; requires explicit numerical scope and broader evidence. User did not require bitwise equivalence, so numerical reassociation alone is not a rejection criterion.

feature_major_mmq.validation_scope: Final outputs strictly compared to original arithmetic with changed routing/inputs/weights and graph replay. Assignment buffer reused between reference and candidate; this is not a poison-coverage proof.

decision: Keep the bitwise norm/RoPE fusion for full-model measurement. Storage and plain scheduling experiments do not establish a broad speed advantage. Weighted atomic accumulation remains experimental and needs model-level numerical validation.
